description: How many people play Minecraft? 212 million monthly players and 350M+ copies sold — the best-selling game ever. Full Minecraft statistics — free for journalists.
text: Research Minecraft Statistics (2026): Sales, Players & Revenue Edwin Crump · 03/07/2026 · 3 min read Free to use with a link back to ShaneTheGamer — compiled and kept up to date from the public sources listed below. Figures reflect the latest available reporting. Last updated: 2026. Minecraft is the best-selling video game of all time and one of the most-played. This page compiles its key 2026 statistics — sales, players and revenue — from Mojang/Microsoft and industry reporting. Key Takeaways for Journalists Minecraft has sold over 350 million copies — the best-selling game ever made. It has around 212 million monthly active players in 2026. It peaked at 222.5 million monthly players in June 2025 — its record. Minecraft has generated over US$4.2 billion in lifetime sales revenue. The game sustains ~ 61.75 million daily active users . Minecraft still sells around 20–25 million copies a year , 15 years on. Minecraft monthly active players, millions. Peaked 222.5M in June 2025. Source: Mojang/Microsoft. How Many Copies Has Minecraft Sold? Minecraft has sold over 350 million copies , making it the best-selling video game in history — ahead of GTA V and, on single-game terms, everything else. Remarkably, it still sells an estimated 20–25 million copies a year more than a decade and a half after its 2011 launch. How Many People Play Minecraft? Minecraft had around 212 million monthly active players in early 2026, having peaked at a record 222.5 million in June 2025. Day-to-day it sustains roughly 61.75 million daily active users and 1.3 million concurrent — extraordinary longevity for a game of its age. Metric 2026 figure Copies sold 350 million+ (best-selling ever) Monthly active players ~212 million Peak MAU 222.5 million (Jun 2025) Daily active users ~61.75 million Lifetime revenue US$4.2 billion+ Annual sales ~20–25 million/year Key Minecraft metrics, 2026. Sources: Mojang/Microsoft, trackers. Why Minecraft Endures Minecraft’s staying power comes from its sandbox openness, cross-platform reach, education edition, and a vast modding and content community. It is a foundational title for a whole generation — see how it compares in our most-played games and best-selling games research. Frequently Asked Questions How many copies has Minecraft sold? Over 350 million copies — making Minecraft the best-selling video game of all time. How many people play Minecraft in 2026? Around 212 million monthly active players , with roughly 61.75 million playing daily. It peaked at 222.5 million monthly in June 2025. Is Minecraft the best-selling game ever? Yes — at 350 million-plus copies, Minecraft is the best-selling single video game in history. How much money has Minecraft made? Minecraft has generated over US$4.2 billion in lifetime sales revenue. Methodology & Sourcing Sales and player figures are from Mojang/Microsoft announcements and industry trackers (Priori Data, Statista). ‘Copies sold’ is the best-selling single game; MAU/DAU are as reported. Rounded and updated as new figures emerge.
